title: Walking with pointers
description:
Write these in `solution.c` by moving pointers, **without** square brackets `[ ]`:

```c
size_t length(const char *s);                          /* like strlen: subtract two pointers */
int *find(int *begin, int *end, int value);            /* the first element equal to value in
                                                          begin..end (end not included), or end */
void copy_string(char *dest, const char *src);         /* like strcpy, terminator included */
const char *last_of(const char *s, char c);            /* the last c in s, or NULL */
```
